verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents its own Callback feature: you supply a URL and the transcription results are POSTed back to it. That is a genuine outbound HTTP callback a programmatic consumer can receive. However, it is set per request for transcription results, not a registrable subscription to a range of event types. missing for 10: account-level registrable webhook subscriptions, a catalog of event types beyond transcription completion, delivery/retry/signature verification docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Deepgram's Callback feature allows you to supply a callback URL to which transcriptions can be returned.
